Terms.introBody: By accessing or using Muhimmak ("the Platform"), including kiosk feedback surveys, staff dashboards, QR code links, and service portals operated by Al Maraghi Auto Services ("Company", "We", "Us"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not access or use the Platform.
Terms.serviceDescriptionBody: Muhimmak is an enterprise customer feedback and quality management system designed to record, evaluate, and analyze customer service experiences across Al Maraghi Auto Services facilities. The Platform provides kiosk survey interfaces, daily rotating QR feedback access, receptionist performance tracking, and automated service analytics.
Terms.authorizedUseBody: Authorized staff members are assigned confidential PINs for authentication. Staff members must maintain the confidentiality of their login credentials and are strictly prohibited from sharing PINs or initiating unauthorized feedback sessions. Falsification of feedback scores, artificially inflating ratings, or creating fraudulent sessions is strictly prohibited and subject to immediate disciplinary and legal action.
Terms.customerConsentBody: Customer participation in feedback surveys is voluntary. Customers may choose to submit feedback anonymously or decline participation at any time prior to survey completion. Responses submitted through the kiosk or QR links are processed for quality enhancement, service monitoring, and staff performance evaluation.
Terms.intellectualPropertyBody: All content, software designs, visual interfaces, logos, domain names, algorithms, and documentation associated with Muhimmak are the exclusive property of Al Maraghi Auto Services or its licensors. Users may not copy, reverse engineer, modify, distribute, or create derivative works from any part of the Platform without prior written consent.
Terms.aiAnalyticsBody: The Platform utilizes server-side artificial intelligence models (such as DeepSeek AI) to process open-text customer feedback, evaluate sentiment, and generate aggregate service performance summaries. AI processing operates on secured server infrastructure and does not use customer responses to train public AI models.

Privacy.subtitle: How Al Maraghi Auto Services collects, protects, uses, and respects customer and staff data within Muhimmak.
Privacy.introBody: Al Maraghi Auto Services ("Company", "We", "Us") is committed to safeguarding the privacy and confidentiality of customer and employee information. This Privacy Policy explains our data collection, storage, processing, and protection practices when using the Muhimmak customer feedback system.
Privacy.dataCollectedBody:
We collect information necessary to deliver and improve our auto service operations, including:
• Survey Feedback: Ratings, star scores, numeric evaluations, and open text feedback provided by customers.
• Vehicle Identifiers: Vehicle plate numbers (when provided) to link feedback with active service work orders and drop-off/pick-up stages.
• Session Metadata: Date, timestamp, language preference (English/Arabic), session duration, and receptionist ID.
• System & Audit Logs: Technical IP addresses, browser user agents, authentication logs, and security audit trails.
Privacy.dataUseBody:
Collected data is processed strictly for legitimate business and quality assurance purposes:
• Evaluating and improving customer service quality across service advisor and technical teams.
• Generating automated alerts for low-satisfaction sessions to enable prompt service recovery.
• Measuring receptionist performance, streaks, and milestone achievements.
• Providing optional high-satisfaction customer redirection to official Google Review pages.
• Analyzing long-term trends and vehicle service journey performance.
Privacy.dataProtectionBody:
We enforce enterprise-grade security measures to protect stored information:
• Encrypted Transmission: All data exchanged between devices, kiosks, and servers is encrypted in transit using industry-standard TLS 1.3 / SSL.
• Row-Level Security (RLS): Supabase PostgreSQL database tables are secured with Row Level Security policies, ensuring strict role-based access control (RBAC).
• Access Isolation: Access to customer feedback reports is strictly restricted based on staff roles (Super Admin, CEO, AGM, Manager, Receptionist).
Privacy.aiPrivacyBody: Muhimmak utilizes AI processing (via DeepSeek API) to analyze sentiment and suggest form criteria. AI API requests are transmitted over encrypted TLS channels using server-side service architecture. Customer data is processed solely for sentiment evaluation and is never retained by third-party AI providers for external model training.
Privacy.dataSharingBody: We do not sell, rent, trade, or share personal data with third-party advertisers or external market research firms. Data is shared exclusively with essential infrastructure providers (Vercel hosting, Supabase cloud database, and OpenAI/DeepSeek server APIs) bound by strict confidentiality and data protection agreements.
Privacy.dataRetentionBody: Customer feedback responses and audit logs are retained for as long as necessary to fulfill quality assurance purposes, resolve service inquiries, and meet statutory record-keeping requirements under UAE law. Outdated audit records and temporary sessions are purged systematically.
Privacy.rightsBody: Under applicable UAE data protection regulations, individuals have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of their personal information held within our systems. Inquiries or data rights requests may be submitted directly to our Compliance Office.
Privacy.contactBody:
